description.en: Welcome from MCCC and the City of Memphis, followed by a dragon dance to open the festival.
description.zh: 中南华人商会及孟菲斯市政府致辞，随后以舞龙表演拉开庆典序幕。

description.en: A traditional folk performance, lively and festive, suitable for all ages.
description.zh: 传统民俗表演，热闹喜庆，老少皆宜。

description.en: Watch artists create spring couplets and ink paintings live, and take one home.
description.zh: 现场观看艺术家书写春联、创作水墨画，并可带走作品。

description.en: Hands-on session where you fold, fill, and taste your own dumplings.
description.zh: 亲手擀皮、包馅、品尝自己包的饺子。

title.en: Traditional Games: Ring Toss, Spinning Tops, Lantern Riddles
title.zh: 传统游戏：套圈、陀螺、猜灯谜

description.en: Drop-in games for kids and adults. Win small prizes.
description.zh: 随到随玩的亲子游戏，赢取小礼品。

description.en: Performances by local dance schools.
description.zh: 本地舞蹈学校献演。

description.en: An introduction to Chinese tea culture with tastings.
description.zh: 中国茶文化介绍与品茗。

description.en: Traditional Chinese martial arts from Memphis-area schools.
description.zh: 孟菲斯地区武馆展示传统中国武术。

title.en: Children's Craft Area: New Year Cards and Origami
title.zh: 儿童手工区：新年贺卡与折纸

description.en: Make a card, fold a paper goat, and string a fairy light.
description.zh: 制作贺卡、折纸羊、串彩灯。

title.en: Live Cooking: New Year's Eve Dinner Classics
title.zh: 现场烹饪：年夜饭经典菜

description.en: Local chefs cook famous reunion dinner dishes and explain their meaning.
description.zh: 本地名厨现场烹制年夜饭名菜并讲解寓意。

description.en: Experience the charm of this quintessential Chinese art form.
description.zh: 领略国粹京剧的魅力。

description.en: Traditional Chinese clothing through the dynasties.
description.zh: 展示历朝历代的传统服饰。

description.en: Walk the lantern path and make your own lantern to take home.
description.zh: 漫步花灯小径，亲手制作花灯带回家。

title.en: New Year's Day Lion Dance and Blessings

description.en: Lion dance and a New Year blessing from community elders.
description.zh: 舞狮表演及社区长者新年祝福。

description.en: Receive a New Year blessing and a lucky red envelope (while supplies last).
description.zh: 领取新年祝福和幸运红包（数量有限）。

description.en: Learn to cut the character for luck and a goat for the new year.
description.zh: 学习剪“福”字和新年羊。

description.en: Singing, instrumental music, and dance by Memphis-area students.
description.zh: 孟菲斯地区学生的歌唱、器乐和舞蹈表演。

title.en: New Year Pastries and Desserts Tasting

description.en: Glutinous rice balls, rice cakes, candied hawthorn, and more.
description.zh: 汤圆、年糕、糖葫芦等传统小吃。

description.en: Stories behind the customs, with the pictorial exhibition.
description.zh: 结合图片展讲述年俗背后的故事。

description.en: Dances from several regions of China.
description.zh: 中国各地区民族舞蹈。

description.en: New Year installation art and traditional costume rental for photos.
description.zh: 新年艺术装置与传统服饰租赁拍照。

description.en: Traditional Chinese martial arts from Memphis-area schools.
description.zh: 孟菲斯地区武馆展示传统中国武术。

description.en: Hands-on session where you fold, fill, and taste your own dumplings.
description.zh: 亲手擀皮、包馅、品尝自己包的饺子。

title.en: Closing Gala: Dragon Dance and Community Chorus
title.zh: 闭幕晚会：舞龙与社区合唱

description.en: The festival closes with a dragon dance and a chorus of New Year songs.
description.zh: 以舞龙和新年歌曲合唱为庆典画上句号。
